python.definition: Python is a high-level, general-purpose programming language.
python.extra: It is popular for AI, machine learning, automation, web development, and data science.

artificial_intelligence.definition: Artificial Intelligence is the field of creating systems capable of performing tasks associated with human intelligence.
artificial_intelligence.extra: Examples include language understanding, image recognition, recommendation systems, and decision support.

machine_learning.definition: Machine Learning is a subset of AI in which algorithms learn patterns from data.
machine_learning.extra: Those patterns can be used for classification, prediction, recommendation, and other tasks.
